events.title: Endless mode is here!
events.summary: Ahoy Captains,It's the Steam Next Fest and with it we are dropping more content for the demo! We expect this will be the final major update for the demo ahead of the main game launch but fear not there's plenty to enjoy.What's new?Endless mode is here. After successfully completing a run you can now continue on into endless mode. Endless mode is exponentially more difficult than the regular voyage so get ready for some up hill battles as you push your build to the limit.A new weapon has arrived.

events.title: Ready your sails, captains
events.summary: Ahoy captains,Coming straight off the back of our previous project, Holding Pattern, we're transitioning from inter-galactic conquests to naval warfare with our studios newest title, GUNBOAT-8GUNBOAT-8 is inspired by popular bullet heaven games such as Brotato and SNKRX but we hope to inject our own taste into the genre to keep things fresh and exciting. We are shortly releasing a free public playtest over on itch, so if you're keen to get your hands on the game early be sure to keep an eye open
